model_annotation: This plot illustrates the coverage achieved by different llama models with varying numbers of completions. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and displays a linear scale from 20 to 27.5, with tick labels spaced approximately every 1 unit, indicating advancements in the number of completed tasks. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and ranges from 0.38 to 0.83, marked with tick intervals of 0.02. Three lines are plotted: a blue solid line representing “Llama-3B”, a green dashed line representing “Llama-3B + FT”, and a pink dotted line representing “Llama-1B”. At the beginning of the x-axis, the blue line is approximately at a coverage value of 0.42, while the green and pink lines are slightly lower at approximately 0.38 and 0.35, respectively. As the x-axis value increases, all three lines steadily increase in coverage, with the blue line reaching a coverage value of 0.78 at x=26.5 and the green line ending at approximately 0.81 at x=27.5, while the pink line ends at approximately 0.72 at x=27.5.
